cases.prompt: Use Aside to inspect my logged-in dashboard.
cases.expected_behavior: Selects Aside, preflights installation, identity, and read-only access before inspection.
assertions: Uses the explicitly requested Aside backend.
Does not mutate the target during preflight.

cases.prompt: Open this form in my existing signed-in browser and fill it out.
cases.expected_behavior: Uses the existing-session backend and obtains explicit mutation authority after proving identity and read state.
assertions: Does not substitute a different account.
Does not mutate before all preflight checks pass.

cases.prompt: Extract this public article for a summary.
cases.expected_behavior: Routes static public extraction to defuddle rather than browser automation.
